tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: App background and the ground behind every screen. Text and text-dim read on it at 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Panels and the HUD bar. Text, text-dim and info read on it at 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, modals and sheets. Text, text-dim and info read on it at 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only. It carries no meaning, so it is not used for control borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of secondary buttons and inputs on bg-0, bg-1 and surface. At least 3:1 on all three.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on bg-0, bg-1, surface and every era sky.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on bg-0, bg-1, surface and every era field.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected states and the amber gem. Pair with on-action for text.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on action fills.

tokens.name: reward
tokens.usage: Rewarded-ad buttons and success marks, always with a word or glyph. Pair with on-reward for text.

tokens.name: on-reward
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on reward fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Lost lives, errors and the lava gem, always with a word or glyph. Pair with on-danger for text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on danger fills.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links, hints and the ice gem, on bg-0, bg-1 and surface at 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Special power-ups and the geode gem, on bg-0, bg-1 and surface at 3:1 or more.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch focus ring. Draw it 3px wide with a 2px gap so it lands on the ground, never on a filled button.

tokens.name: gem-lava
tokens.usage: Lava-stone gem, drawn as a diamond.

tokens.name: gem-amber
tokens.usage: Amber gem, drawn as a hexagon.

tokens.name: gem-jade
tokens.usage: Jade gem, drawn as a square.

tokens.name: gem-ice
tokens.usage: Ice-crystal gem, drawn as a circle.

tokens.name: gem-geode
tokens.usage: Geode gem, drawn as a triangle.

tokens.name: gem-bone
tokens.usage: Fossil-bone gem, drawn as a star. The sixth kind, added from the Devonian era.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Era names and screen titles such as Level complete. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Scores, level numbers and modal titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Captions in history videos, consent text and journal facts.
styles.sample: The sky turned dark and the long summer ended.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Hints and secondary lines under headings.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The Ad tag, counters' labels and HUD captions. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between two tappable controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside counters and tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and screen margins.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between a reward button and a Next or Play button.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large separation, and the grid pitch of the cover pattern.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs. Blocks use half of it.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, modals and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counters, tags and progress bars.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of any tappable control.

tokens.name: hud-height
tokens.usage: Height of the top HUD bar, the same in both games.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Logical width of the portrait play canvas, scaled to the screen.

tokens.name: canvas-height
tokens.usage: Logical height of the portrait play canvas, scaled to the screen.

duration.note: Motion timings. Under the reduced-motion setting, set all three to 0ms and stop shake and particles.

tokens.name: duration-feedback
tokens.usage: Press states and hit feedback.

tokens.name: duration-ui
tokens.usage: Screen, modal and sheet transitions.

tokens.name: duration-reward
tokens.usage: Coin counts, star reveals and reward pops.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The one easing curve for every transition.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: HUD bar above the canvas.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Ad overlay and history video.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and consent sheet.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.
